 Apple TV confirms Brad Pitt will star in Connector
 Thursday, 12 November 2026, 22:14 
 Photo source: 9to5Mac 
 Apple TV reposted a report about Connector, a new Apple Original Films project starring Brad Pitt and directed by Darius Marder. 
 Deadline reported that Apple Original Films is producing Connector, with Pitt set to star and Sound of Metal director Darius Marder directing. Apple TV’s account on X reposted the report, confirming the news.
 This is reported by 9to5Mac .
 The film’s logline says it is “set in 1970s New York and revolves around a working-class legend, a sky-walking ironworker who takes on forces larger than himself.”
 Advertisement 
 Apple has previously worked with Pitt on F1 The Movie and Wolfs, which also starred George Clooney. Wolfs was a hit for Apple TV, but the company’s handling of its release put it on shaky ground with the creatives involved. The film was planned for a wide theatrical release, but shortly before its premiere Apple changed course and canceled those plans, making it streaming-only.
 The experience apparently did not sour Pitt on the relationship. If it did, F1 The Movie becoming a major theatrical hit may have helped repair it.
 Apple TV costs $14.99 per month and is also available at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
